title.en: Dua for protection of Imam-e-Zamana (a) after every obligatory namaz.
title.rurdu: Har Waajib Namaz ke baad Imam-e-Zamana (a) ki hifaazat ki dua.
title.urdu: ہر نماز کے بعد امام عصر (عج) کے ظہور کی دُعا۔

desc.en: Imam Jawad (a) recommended to recite the following supplication when you finish your compulsory prayers…
desc.rurdu: Hazrat Imam Jawad (a) farmate hai keh; jab Waajib Namaz se faarigh ho to is tarah se kaho…
desc.urdu: حضرت امام جواد فرماتے ہیں جب آپ واجب نماز سے فارغ ہوجائیں تو کہو۔۔۔

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: رَضِیْتُ بِاللہِ رَبًّا، وَ بِالْاِسْلَامِ دِیْنًا، وَبِالْقُرْآنِ کِتَابًا، بِمُحَمَّد نَبِیًّا، وَبِعَلِیٍّ وَلِیًّا، وَبِالْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَیْنِ، وَعَلِیِّ بْنِ الْحُسَیْنِ، وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ، وَجَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَمُوْسَی بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، وَعَلِیِّ بْنِ مُوْسٰی، وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ، وَعَلِیِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَالْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ، وَالْحُجَّۃِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ اَئِمَّۃً۔

lines.rarabic: RAZITO BILLAAHE RABBAN, WA BIL-ISLAA-ME DEE-NAN, WA BIL QUR’AANE KITAA-BAN, WA BE-MOHAMMADIN NABIYYAN WA BE-A’LIYYIN WALIYYAN, WA BIL-HASANE WAL HUSAINE, WA ALIYYIB-NIL HUSAINE, WA MOHAMMADIB-NE ALIYYIN, WA JA’FA-RIBNE MOHAMMADIN, WA MOOSAB-NE JA’FARIN, WA A’LIY-YIBNE MOOSAA, WA MOHAMMADIB-NE, WA ALIY-YIBNE MOHAMMADIN, WAL-HASA-NIBNE ALIYYIN, WAL HUJJA-TIB-NIL HASA-NIBNE ALIYYIN AIMMATAN.

trans.en: I am pleased with Allah as god and with Islam as religion and with Qur'an as book of guidance and with Muhammad (s.a.w.a) as Prophet and with Ali (a.s) as guardian and with Hasan (a.s) and Hussain (a.s) and Ali son of Husain (a.s) and Muhammad son of Ali (a.s) and Ja’far son of Muhammad (a.s) and Musa son of Ja'far (a.s) and Ali son of Musa (a.s) and Muhammad son Ali (a.s) and Ali son of Muhammad (a.s) and Hasan son of Ali (a.s) and Al-Hujjah (a.t.f.s) son of Hasan son of Ali the Imam.
trans.rurdu: Mai raazi hu is par keh Allah mera Rab, Islam mera deen, Qur’an meri kitaab, Muhammad (s.a.w.a) mere Nabi aur Ali (a.s) mere Imam hai. Neez Hazrat Hasan (a.s) wa Husain (a.s) wa Sajjad (a.s) wa Muhammad Baqir (a.s) wa Jafar Sadiq (a.s) wa Moosa Kazim (a.s) wa Ali Reza (a.s) wa Muhammad Taqi (a.s) wa Ali Naqi (a.s) wa Hasan Askari (a.s) aur Hazrat Mahdi Al-Qaaem (a.t.f.s) mere Imam, Sardaar aur Rehbar hai.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰہُمَّ وَلِیُّکَ الْحُجَّۃُ فَاحْفَظْہُ مِنْ بَیْنِ یَدَیْہِ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِہٖ وَعَنْ یَمِیْنِہٖ وَعَنْ شِمَالِہٖ، وَمِنْ فَوْقِہٖ، وَمِنْ تَحْتِہٖ، وَامْدُدْ لَہٗ فِیْ عُمْرِہٖ، وَجَعَلَئْہُ الْقَاۗئِمَ بِاَمْرِکَ، اَلْمُنْتَصِرَ لِدِیْنِکَ، وَاَرِہٖ مَا یُحِبُّ وَتَقَرُّ بِہٖ عَیْنُہٗ فِیْ نَفْسِہٖ وَفِیْ ذُرِّیَّتِہٖ، وَاَھْلِہٖ وَمَالِہٖ، وَفِیْ شِیْعَتِہٖ وَفِیْ عُدُوِّہٖ، وَاَرِہِمْ مِنْہُ مَا یَحْذَرُوْنَ، وَاَرِہٖ فِیْہِمْ مَا یُحِبُّ وَتَقَرُّبِہٖ عَیْنُہٗ، وَاشْفِ بِہٖ صُدُوْرَنَا وَصُدُوْرَ قَوْمٍ مُّؤْمِنِیْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA WALIYYO-KAL HUJJATO FAH-FAZHO MIM-BAIYNE YA-DAIY-HE, WA MIN KHALFE-HI WA A’N YAMEENE-HI WA A’N SHE-MAALE-HI, WA MIN FAWQE-HI, WA MIN TAH-TEHI, WAM-DUD LAHU FEE U’MRE-HI, WA JA-A’LA-HUL QAAA-E-MA BE-AMRE-KA, AL-MUNTA-SERA LE-DEENE-KA, WA ARE-HI MAA YO-HIBBO WA TAQAR-RO BEHI A’Y-NAHU FEE NAFSE-HI WA FEE ZURRIY-YATE-HI, WA AHLE-HI WA MAALE-HI, WA FEE SHAIY-A’TE-HI WA FEE O’DOOWE-HI, WA A-RE-HIM MINHO MAA YAH-ZAROO-NA, WA A-RE-HI FEE-HIM MAA YO-HIBBO WA TA-QARRO-BEHI A’IY-NOHU, WASH-FE BEHI SODOO-RANAA WA SODOO-RA QAW-MIM MOME-NEENA.

trans.en: O Allah! Protect Your legacy the proof from his front, his back, his right and left sides, above him and under him and prolong his life, make him to uphold Your command, victorious in Your religion, showed him what he want in himself and in his descendant and in his family and properties and in his followers and in his enemy and showed them what they were cautioned of , show him in them what he wishes that will please him and tranquil ours and the believers mind with him.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Hujjat al Qaim (a.t.f.s) Tere Wali hai, Mawla har taraf se, saamne se, pichhe se, daahine se, baaye’n se, uppar se neeche se, mehfooz rakhna. Unki umr mein izaafa farma, Unhe Apne Amr se qayaam karne waala qaraar de, aur unhe Apne deen ki madad karne waala qaraar de, aur unhe har woh cheez ataa farma jo unki pasand ho aur jis se unki ankho’n ko thandak milti ho. Unki zaat ke baare mein, unke ahel o ayaal aur chaha ne waalo’n ke baare mein, hadd yeh hai keh khud unke dushmano ke baare mein aur dushmano ko woh sab kuchh dikhla dena jinse woh khouf-zadah ho aur chaha ne waalo’n ko momeneen ko jis se unki ankho’n ko thandak miley aur dil ko sukoon o itmenaan.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔

desc.en: The tradition is proving the ascertainment of supplication for the relief of our master Al-Hujjat (a) after every compulsory prayers.
desc.rurdu: Is hadees se Hazrat Sahebaz Zamaan (a) ke zahoor ke liye har Waajib Namaz ke baad dua ki ehmiyat ka andaaza hota hai.
desc.urdu: اس حدیث شریف سے ہر واجب نماز کے بعد آخری حجت کی فرض کے لئے دعا کی اہمیت معلوم ہوتی ہے۔
